summary.text: This opportunity briefing explores combining normalizing flows, parameter estimation, and regression for simulation-based parameter estimation and joint state-parameter estimation in physical or dynamic systems. Traditional estimation approaches suffer performance degradation when handling nonlinear systems whose uncertainty follows arbitrary non-Gaussian or multi-modal distributions. The proposed combination integrates normalizing flows into parameter estimation schemes to transform complex residual or error distributions into simple base distributions, facilitating end-to-end simulation-based estimation and nonlinear filtering.

target_user.text: The target user is unverified due to a lack of patent assignee categories and user-specific descriptions in the bundle, though technical implementers can leverage provided open-source repositories and packages such as torchcfm and lightgbmlss.

jtbd.text: When researchers and engineers model physical or dynamic systems with complex non-Gaussian uncertainties, they want to accurately estimate parameters and joint states, so that they can overcome the performance degradation of traditional filtering and estimation algorithms.

value_prop.text: By integrating normalizing flows into parameter estimation schemes, complex residual or error distributions are transformed into simple base distributions. This enables robust end-to-end simulation-based estimation and advanced nonlinear filtering for complex systems.
